subject: general
question: Why is it important to protect the stator core from damage while removing burnt winding wires?

options.text: Damage to the core will result in an increase in the overall size of the motor, thereby affecting its performance.
This is the cause of reduced motor efficiency and an irregular magnetic flux distribution resulting from a damaged core.
System instability arises from the excessively strong mechanical vibrations generated by the damaged stator core.
It is not possible to perform winding without damaging the stator slots.

solution:
The correct answer is __This is the cause of reduced motor efficiency and an irregular magnetic flux distribution resulting from a damaged core.__
